backdrop.public/game/backgrounds/fort-lauderdale/: Create a scenery-only wide side-scrolling backdrop for an original game called South Florida Fighter. Landscape canvas as wide as supported, near 3:2 or wider. Elaborately hand-pixeled late-1990s 32-bit arcade background art with deliberate clusters, stepped diagonals, shapes rendered in warm/cool planes and crisp edges; original design. Flat side-on camera with very limited perspective, no dramatic single-point street receding into the center. Build attractive scenery across the full width including both ends so a tall mobile camera moving horizontally always sees a balanced crop. The whole bottom quarter as lower-contrast distant architecture/scenery for sprite legibility, scenery extends to the bottom edge. Game floor, playable geometry and sprites are rendered separately. No in-game HUD, text, typography, signage lettering, brand marks, characters, foreground props, playable floor or platforms. Perfectly edge-to-edge scene, no frame, no black bars, no imitation of an existing game. Setting: A1A Ocean Boardwalk. Late golden hour after a light rain, looking side-on out across an oceanfront promenade toward the Atlantic. Modern ivory and coral beachfront condos in the far distance, long pale sand beach and aqua water, a distant classic lifeguard tower and sea oats, pink-apricot clouds above blue-green water. Quiet indigo coastal shadows behind where fighters will appear.

ground.sourceSheetPrompt: Production texture sheet containing precisely five stacked horizontal material bands across the full image width, equal-height bands with hard straight horizontal separations and NO gaps. Each band is self-contained and nearly seamless at the left and right edges, viewed almost straight down with a slight side-on perspective. TOP FIFTH weathered honey-tone ocean boardwalk wood with long horizontal planks. SECOND FIFTH warm dark reddish Ybor brick pavers laid in rows. THIRD FIFTH pearl-beige Worth Avenue limestone rectangular pavers with a slight warm pink tone. FOURTH FIFTH Wynwood charcoal concrete slabs with subtle purple tones and restrained pink paint flecks. BOTTOM FIFTH Ocean Drive muted warm gray art deco terrazzo with extremely subtle turquoise and coral aggregate. All low contrast, long horizontal visual flow, painted 16-bit arcade pixel art, careful texture clusters and consistent visual scale. NO text, objects, signs, shadows cast by objects, staged layouts, borders or borders between rows. Wide landscape 3:2 canvas.

stageProps: Pixel-art video game prop atlas, 5 columns by 2 rows, exactly one coastal Florida arcade brawler stage prop centered within each cell, all isolated on fully transparent alpha background. Each object has a clear silhouette, pixel-level shading, and ample padding, no sheet labels or signs. Top row left to right: blue and ivory beach lifeguard chair, warm amber wrought-iron street lamp, white stone urn with pink flowers, orange-red fire hydrant, cyan Art Deco bollard. Bottom row: two leaning surfboards, wooden shipping crate, small limestone fountain with blue water, paint-supply crate with spray cans, pink Art Deco planter with purple foliage. Never allow objects to touch each other. Orthographic side-on camera. Wide landscape image.
